meta.pageTitle: Chapter 8: Metals and Alloys — Interactive Physics Book
meta.description: Chapter Eight of the Interactive Physics Book: Metals and Alloys — properties of metals, their extraction and purification, the definition of alloys, their types, manufacturing methods, and uses — with interactive tools and solved questions.
meta.footer: Chapter Eight: Metals and Alloys — Interactive Physics Book

hero.eyebrow: 📘 Interactive Physics Book · Part Two: Chemistry
hero.lead: From metals' place in the periodic table and their four properties, to their extraction and purification according to the activity series, and on to the world of alloys: their definition, types, manufacturing methods, and uses in our lives and our Iraqi setting.

objectivesLead: After completing this chapter, the student will be able to:
objectives: Know the methods of extracting metals and the methods of purifying them.
Know the devices used in the extraction process.
Know some examples needed for the purification process of certain metals.
Know alloys, their properties, and their types.
Know the methods of manufacturing alloys.
Know some types of alloys in our daily lives.

lessons.title: Metals
lessons.description: 8-1: The position of metals in the periodic table, and their four main properties.

lessons.title: Methods and Devices Used in Extracting Metals
lessons.description: 8-2: The activity series, reduction reactions, and the extraction method suited to each metal.

lessons.title: Methods and Devices Used in Purifying Metals
lessons.description: 8-3: Ore concentration, aluminum extraction, froth flotation, and the recycling cycle.

lessons.title: Alloys
lessons.description: 8-4: The definition of an alloy, and a historical note on its discovery, from iron meteorites to bronze.

lessons.title: Types of Alloys
lessons.description: 8-5: Single-phase alloys and multi-phase alloys, and the properties of alloys.

lessons.title: Methods of Making Alloys
lessons.description: 8-6: The direct method, and the indirect method with its one-stage and two-stage variants.

lessons.title: Uses of Alloys
lessons.description: 8-7: Cooling and fire detection, medicine, aircraft, buildings and bridges, and the most famous examples.

lessons.title: Some Types of Alloys Used in the Iraqi Setting
lessons.description: 8-8: Iraqi coin alloys, lead alloy, and stainless steel.

lessons.title: Chapter Eight Questions
lessons.description: All the official end-of-chapter questions, solved in detail.
